source: Implementation support changes faster than the mathematics. For deployed systems, treat the exact installed framework, model code, and attention-kernel documentation as authoritative for supported devices, dtypes, masks, head dimensions, cache layouts, and fused ZXNAME0000XZ/ZXNAME0001XZ behavior.
